description: Open-source usage references. Component implementations and executable examples are available in src and workshop.

examples.expression: `<Button variant="${buttonVariant}" size="${buttonSize}" onClick={handleClick}>\n  Try this button\n</Button>`
'<Input label="Work email" type="email"\n  value={email} onChange={handleChange}\n  error={error} required />'
'<Badge tone="success">Approved</Badge>'

'

Archive this record?

'
'<Chart type="line" label="Records by month"\n  data={monthlyRecords} max={240} showDataTable={showData} />'
'<Widget title="Workspace activity" description="Records · Apr–Sep 2026"\n  chart={chart} loading={loading} error={error}\n  recovery={<Button onClick={retry}>Retry</Button>} />'
'<Alert tone="danger" title="A workspace name is required">\n  Add a name and try again.\n</Alert>'

'<ToastProvider>
  <Toast open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}
    title="Record archived" action={undoAction} />
  <ToastViewport />
</ToastProvider>'
'<Progress label="Importing records" value={progress} />'
'<section aria-label="Records" aria-busy={loading}>\n  {loading ? <Skeleton shape="card" /> : <Records />}\n</section>'
'<EmptyState title="A fresh start."\n  description="Create your first record to get started."\n  action={<Button onClick={createRecord}>Create record</Button>} />'
'<Textarea label="Workspace description"\n  value={description} onChange={handleChange}\n  maxLength={280} helperText={characterCount} />'

'<Select label="Record category" value={category}
  onChange={handleChange}>
  <option value="operations">Operations</option>
  <option value="research">Research</option>
</Select>'

'<Select multiple label="Workspace teams" name="teams"
  placeholder="Select teams" value={teams}
  onValueChange={setTeams}>
  <option value="operations">Operations</option>
  <option value="product">Product</option>
  <option value="support">Support</option>
</Select>'

'<fieldset>
  <legend>Report frequency</legend>
  <Radio label="Daily" name="frequency" value="daily" />
  <Radio label="Weekly" name="frequency" value="weekly" defaultChecked />
</fieldset>'
'<Switch label="Email notifications"\n  checked={enabled}\n  onChange={event => setEnabled(event.target.checked)} />'
'<OTPInput label="Verification code"\n  name="code" value={code}\n  onValueChange={setCode} error={error} required />'
'<PasswordInput label="New password"\n  name="password" autoComplete="new-password"\n  minLength={12} required />'

'<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <IconButton aria-label="Record actions" icon={<MoreIcon />} />
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={duplicateRecord}>Duplicate record</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>'
'<Button variant="primary">\n  Save changes\n</Button>'
'<Tag onRemove={removeTeam} removeLabel="Remove Product team">\n  Product team\n</Tag>'
'<Avatar name="Alex Morgan" size={40} aria-hidden />'
'<Link href="#input">Update profile details</Link>'

'<Tabs defaultValue="all" activationMode="manual">
  <TabsList aria-label="Record views">
    <TabsTrigger value="all">All records</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="all">...</TabsContent>
</Tabs>'
"<Pagination page={page} totalItems={70} pageSize={7}\n  onPageChange={setPage} />"
"<Navbar leading={breadcrumb} search={search}\n  actions={actions} items={mobileRoutes} />"
"<Sidebar compact={compact} brand={brand}\n  compactBrand={compactBrand} items={routes}\n  workspace={workspaceAction} account={accountAction} />"
"<Stepper steps={steps} currentStep={step}\n  onStepChange={setStep} />"
'<Dialog><DialogTrigger asChild><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger>\n  <DialogContent title="Archive this record?" footer={actions} />\n</Dialog>'
'<Drawer><DrawerTrigger asChild><Button>Open panel</Button></DrawerTrigger>\n  <DrawerContent title="Record details"><RecordForm /></DrawerContent>\n</Drawer>'
'<TooltipProvider><Tooltip content="Archive a record without deleting it">\n  <Button>Archive</Button>\n</Tooltip></TooltipProvider>'
'<Popover><PopoverTrigger asChild><Button>Location</Button></PopoverTrigger>\n  <PopoverContent aria-label="Current location">...</PopoverContent>\n</Popover>'

"<DropdownMenu><DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button>Actions</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>\n  <DropdownMenuContent><DropdownMenuItem onSelect={edit}>Edit record</DropdownMenuItem></DropdownMenuContent>\n</DropdownMenu>"

'<DatePicker label="Review date" name="date"
  value={date} onValueChange={setDate} required />
<DatePicker mode="range" label="Reporting period"
  value={range} onValueChange={setRange} />'

'<TimePicker label="Meeting start" name="start"
  defaultValue="09:30" format="12h" />
<TimePicker label="Reminder time" minuteStep={15}
  min="08:00" max="18:00" />'
'<Calendar startDate="2026-10-05" events={events}\n  onEventClick={openEvent} />'

`
